title: Search latency cache
body: Search latency improves when the cache stores normalized queries. Measure cache hit rate and invalidation delay separately.

title: Index recovery notebook
body: The search index snapshot restores postings after a storage fault. Recovery validates checksums before serving traffic.

title: Cache invalidation contract
body: Cache invalidation uses versioned keys. A stale search response is rejected when the document revision changes.

title: Retrieval channel fusion
body: Search retrieval combines lexical lists using reciprocal rank fusion. Missing channel membership contributes zero rather than an invented rank.

title: Latency budget experiment
body: A search latency budget separates queue time, index lookup and cache misses. The synthetic workload is not a production measurement.

title: Storage replication protocol
body: Storage replication retains committed sequence numbers. Recovery reconciles replicas before promoting a new leader.

title: Document tag migration
body: Search metadata tags migrate with a schema revision. Validate all documents before switching the active index.

title: Filter relaxation trace
body: Search filters relax year before kind and collection. The trace records every dropped predicate so a wider result is inspectable.

title: Vector namespace setup
body: Vector retrieval needs a consistent embedding model and dimension for documents and queries. Text indexing is configured separately.

title: Queue backpressure
body: Backpressure bounds queued requests. Reject work early rather than exhausting memory under a stalled consumer.

title: Provider retry boundaries
body: Retry transient rate limits and server failures with bounded backoff. Invalid credentials are terminal failures rather than repeated attempts.

title: Ranking rubric inspection
body: Ranking criteria must cite document evidence. Missing evidence fails hard criteria; soft evidence is scored on an explicit ordinal rubric.

title: Cache eviction sketch
body: Cache eviction trades memory occupancy against repeated search lookup. Deterministic ties help reproduce an offline experiment.

title: Replay artifact format
body: A replay artifact includes schema version, corpus digest, query and algorithm settings. A digest detects mismatch but is not authentication.

title: Tokenization limits
body: ASCII tokenization misses multilingual morphology and semantic synonyms. Lexical scores are deterministic features, not semantic embeddings.

title: Search cache evidence
body: Search cache metrics include latency percentiles, cache hit rate and revision freshness. This note is a fictional engineering fixture.

title: Scorer failure policy
body: An invalid ranking rubric produces a rejected candidate. Never pad a short result with a document that failed required evidence.

title: API request inspection
body: Local inspection exports neutral document fields only. Credentials, vectors and arbitrary provider metadata are not report attributes.
